title: Unique additive localization of a linear functor
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, C and D R-linear preadditive categories [def-weil-linear-category], t an element of R, and U:C → D an additive R-linear functor. Write L_t(C), L_t(D) for the raw scalar localizations [def-weil-linear-scalar-localization], with unchanged objects and Hom groups R[1/t] tensor_R Hom. There exists a unique additive functor F:L_t(C) → L_t(D) whose object at K is U(K) and whose map on every pure tensor c tensor a is c tensor U(a), for every c in R[1/t] and every integral arrow a. The formulas use heterogeneous equality to accommodate the stated object identifications.

proof.text: Use the semilinear extension with the identity coefficient homomorphism. Its coefficient map is the identity by uniqueness. The extension has the stated object and pure-tensor formulas. For uniqueness, use functor extensionality and induction on each tensor Hom group; additivity handles zero and sums, and the prescribed formula handles pure tensors.

lean.statement:
theorem functor_existsUnique
    {R : Type r} [CommRing R]
    {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] [Preadditive C] [Linear R C]
    {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D] [Preadditive D] [Linear R D]
    (t : R) (U : C ⥤ D) [U.Additive] [U.Linear R] :
    ∃! F : ScalarLocalization R C t ⥤ ScalarLocalization R D t,
      F.Additive ∧ (∀ K, F.obj K = ⟨U.obj K.obj⟩) ∧
      (∀ (K L : C) (a : K ⟶ L) (c : Localization.Away t),
        HEq (F.map (c ⊗ₜ[R] a : ScalarLocalization.mk K ⟶ ScalarLocalization.mk L))
          (c ⊗ₜ[R] U.map a))
